metadataLimits: Ordinary QA files only. Git recovery plus recorded mode/mtimeMs preserves bytes/mode/millisecond mtime when applied explicitly; xattrs and sub-millisecond mtime restoration are not promised. APFS snapshots or unknown clones may pin extents, so adjusted bytes are not a guaranteed df delta.
recovery: Stream git cat-file blob <gitBlob> to the exact recorded originalPath after making its parent; verify bytes and SHA256, restore mode and mtimeMs. Keep this backup ref reachable. Do not overwrite an existing different file. No restoration or removal has been executed.

whitelistClassification.reason: Full tmp scan revealed earlier v2 raw-failure and encoded QA screenshot directories. Every candidate is byte-identical to a docs/evidence QA blob in the pinned backup commit; none is source, original generated art, preview, simulation or Git storage. Whitelist is a proposal for controller revalidation, not removal authorization.
